description: Belib' - Points de recharge pour véhicules électriques - Données statiques is a dataset listed in Paris Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements - Ville de Paris. Donnée géolocalisée des points de recharge [ Bélib' ] pour véhicules électriques en service. Belib’ est le réseau public parisien de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques, opéré par Total Marketing France depuis mars 2021. Il comprend environ 2000 points de charge répartis sur 430 stations, dont une partie des anciennes stations Autolib’. Coverage: Paris. The portal files it under Mobilité et Espace Public. Its keywords are Belib, IRVE, BRVE, DVD, véhicule électrique, rechargement. The portal shows 1,886 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-paris-fr-portal.
